event: "Just a Talented," Nala says; she hadn't tried her Talent like that before. Garth's brow climbs.

changes.note: The Sea refills her well within the hour

event: She asks after others bitten, for practice. Garth laughs: two of his own ewes, lame and sour.

memory.fact: Two of Garth's ewes took greymaw scratches at the fold and have gone lame and sour with rot.
Two of Garth's ewes took greymaw scratches at the fold and have gone lame and sour with rot.

event: And the miller's girl at the Ford, Tansy Horne, bitten ten days back, worse than Wren was.

memory.fact: Garth says the miller's girl at the Ford, Tansy Horne, was bitten ten days back and is bad.
Garth says the miller's girl at the Ford, Tansy Horne, was bitten ten days back and is bad.
Garth says Tansy is worse than Wren was, and Horne's silver has not helped her.
Garth says Tansy is worse than Wren was, and Horne's silver has not helped her.

event: "Goody Brannoc at the Ford tends all the rot-sick. She'd know who else."

memory.fact: Garth says Goody Brannoc at the Ford tends all the rot-sick, and would know who else.
Garth says Goody Brannoc at the Ford tends all the rot-sick, and would know who else.

event: Wren tugs her sleeve: will she come back, and tell what Talent she's got?

memory.fact: Wren asked Nala to come back and to tell her what Talent she has.
Wren asked Nala to come back and to tell her what Talent she has.

event: Garth kneels at the chest under the loft ladder and lifts out worn boots and a brown wool cloak.

memory.fact: Garth keeps his dead wife Anni's boots and cloak in a chest, and could be brought to part with them.
Garth keeps his dead wife Anni's boots and cloak in a chest, and could be brought to part with them.

event: "These were my Anni's. Wren's mam. She's three winters gone." He holds them out to Nala.

memory.fact: Garth offers Nala the worn boots and brown wool cloak of Anni, Wren's mother, three winters dead.
Garth offers Nala the worn boots and brown wool cloak of Anni, Wren's mother, three winters dead.

event: Nala takes them with both hands; the boots fit laced tight, the cloak smells faintly of cedar.

make.title: Anni's Boots
make.description: A pair of worn brown leather boots, laced to the shin, a little large for her.

changes.note: Garth gives Nala his dead wife Anni's boots

make.title: Anni's Cloak
make.description: A hooded cloak of heavy brown wool, patched at the hem and smelling faintly of cedar.

changes.note: Garth gives Nala his dead wife Anni's cloak

memory.fact: Anni's boots are a little large for Nala, but serve well with the laces pulled tight.
Anni's boots are a little large for Nala, but serve well with the laces pulled tight.
Anni's brown wool cloak is heavy and soft, and smells faintly of cedar from Garth's chest.
Anni's brown wool cloak is heavy and soft, and smells faintly of cedar from Garth's chest.

event: Ten days since Tansy was bitten, not ten days left; the Ford is an hour and a half at his pace.

memory.fact: Garth says the ten days are since Tansy was bitten, and nobody knows how long she has left.
Garth says the ten days are since Tansy was bitten, and nobody knows how long she has left.
At Garth's limping pace the three miles to the Ford take about an hour and a half.
At Garth's limping pace the three miles to the Ford take about an hour and a half.

event: Nala asks him to guide her there now, or at least to Goody Brannoc.
"Go, Da," Wren says, flushed but bright-eyed. "I'm better. Burr can mind me."

memory.fact: Wren urged Garth to take Nala to the Ford, saying Burr can mind her while he is gone.
Wren urged Garth to take Nala to the Ford, saying Burr can mind her while he is gone.
With the rot drawn, Wren is still flushed but bright-eyed, and says she is better.
With the rot drawn, Wren is still flushed but bright-eyed, and says she is better.

event: Goody brought Wren into the world, and Horne lets in anyone Goody says; Garth will take her.

memory.fact: Goody Brannoc brought Wren into the world, and Garth's word carries weight with her.
Goody Brannoc brought Wren into the world, and Garth's word carries weight with her.
Garth says Horne will let in to see Tansy anyone Goody Brannoc vouches for.
Garth says Horne will let in to see Tansy anyone Goody Brannoc vouches for.
Garth has agreed to leave Wren and walk Nala to the Ford now, to speak for her to Goody Brannoc.
Garth has agreed to leave Wren and walk Nala to the Ford now, to speak for her to Goody Brannoc.

event: Rising, Nala's tide brushes the pot: the grey salt is not dead, and its reach leans toward Wren.

memory.fact: The rot salt in Garth's plain iron pot is not dead; it crawls slowly toward the nearest warm life.
The rot salt in Garth's plain iron pot is not dead; it crawls slowly toward the nearest warm life.

event: Garth: Goody burns every poultice that's touched rot, in a hot fire, and never uses one twice.

memory.fact: Garth says Goody burns every poultice that has touched rot, in a hot fire, and never reuses one.
Garth says Goody burns every poultice that has touched rot, in a hot fire, and never reuses one.

event: He hands her the pot's iron lid from its hook by the hearth, and she presses it on.

memory.fact: The iron lid of Garth's pot hangs on a hook by his hearth, where a peat fire burns.
The iron lid of Garth's pot hangs on a hook by his hearth, where a peat fire burns.

event: The lid is plain iron too; the salt's sour reach passes through it, still leaning toward Wren.

memory.fact: A plain iron lid does not stop the pot's rot salt; its faint reach still leans toward Wren.
A plain iron lid does not stop the pot's rot salt; its faint reach still leans toward Wren.
Plain iron neither holds nor kills rot salt; within hours it seeps through, as damp through clay.
Plain iron neither holds nor kills rot salt; within hours it seeps through, as damp through clay.

event: "Your call, lass. You can feel it; I can't." Nala decides to try burning it.

memory.fact: Garth cannot feel the rot salt himself, and leaves to Nala the call on how to be rid of it.
Garth cannot feel the rot salt himself, and leaves to Nala the call on how to be rid of it.

event: Garth heaps dry gorse and split ash on the peat and works the bellows till the fire roars.

memory.fact: Garth keeps a basket of dry gorse and split ash by the hearth to build the fire up fast.
Garth keeps a basket of dry gorse and split ash by the hearth to build the fire up fast.

event: She tips the salt into the flames; it spits like fat, stinks of brine, and its sour reach goes out.

memory.fact: In a hot fire rot salt spits, stinks and burns away to clean white ash.
In a hot fire rot salt spits, stinks and burns away to clean white ash.

event: Only clean white ash is left; nothing sour remains in the room but the smell.

memory.fact: The rot salt from Wren burned to white ash in Garth's hearth fire; no rot is left at Marsh Croft.
The rot salt from Wren burned to white ash in Garth's hearth fire; no rot is left at Marsh Croft.

event: Garth props the door, kisses Wren's head, and they set out down the lane; Burr whines behind.
The valley opens: brown fields, sheep, farm smoke; she slows to his limp, warm in the cloak.
Across the river the white mountains stand into cloud. "Whitecombs," Garth says.
After an hour and more the lane meets the river and runs beside it to a village of stone houses.

memory.fact: The lane from Marsh Croft meets the river and runs along beside it to Wendle Ford.
The lane from Marsh Croft meets the river and runs along beside it to Wendle Ford.
Wendle Ford has stone houses, a ford with a stone footbridge, and a mill wheel at its east end.
Wendle Ford has stone houses, a ford with a stone footbridge, and a mill wheel at its east end.

event: Past the mill, Garth knocks at a crooked cottage by the mill race, herbs drying under its eaves.

memory.fact: Goody Brannoc, herbwife and the valley's only healer, lives by the mill race.
Goody Brannoc, herbwife and the valley's only healer, lives by the mill race.

event: A tiny, bent old woman with sharp black eyes opens it; her nose wrinkles, as if at a smell.

memory.fact: Goody Brannoc is a tiny, bent old woman with sharp black eyes, in a cottage by the mill race.
Goody Brannoc is a tiny, bent old woman with sharp black eyes, in a cottage by the mill race.
Her Knack lets her smell sickness and rot in a body from across a room.

event: Her eyes go to Nala's face; the rag falls and she whitens: "Liss? Liss Aske?"

memory.fact: At the sight of Nala's face Goody went white and whispered, "Liss? Liss Aske?"
At the sight of Nala's face Goody went white and whispered, "Liss? Liss Aske?"
Nala's face stops Goody's breath: it is the face of her girlhood friend Liss Aske, unchanged.
Nala's face stops Goody's breath: it is the face of her girlhood friend Liss Aske, unchanged.

event: "Who? I'm Nala, just a Talented passing through." Goody's hand comes out of her apron with a nail.

memory.fact: Goody keeps an iron nail in her apron.
Goody keeps an iron nail in her apron.
Goody fears the tarn has sent back a drowned thing, and would test Nala with cold iron first.
Goody fears the tarn has sent back a drowned thing, and would test Nala with cold iron first.

event: She presses it flat to Nala's wrist: cold, dead and numbing, and nothing more. The skin is unmarked.

memory.fact: Cold iron does not burn Nala; against her skin it only feels cold, dead and numbing.
Cold iron does not burn Nala; against her skin it only feels cold, dead and numbing.
Goody pressed cold iron to Nala's wrist; it left no mark, so she judged Nala no drowned thing.
Goody pressed cold iron to Nala's wrist; it left no mark, so she judged Nala no drowned thing.

event: "Cold iron. Doesn't burn you. Then you're no drowned thing come back."
Liss Aske was her dearest friend: red-haired, drowned in Hollow Tarn fifty-one winters gone, at 25.

memory.fact: Goody says Liss Aske was her dearest friend, red-haired, drowned in Hollow Tarn 51 winters ago.
Goody says Liss Aske was her dearest friend, red-haired, drowned in Hollow Tarn 51 winters ago.
Goody says Liss Aske was twenty-five when she drowned, and Nala's face is hers not a day older.
Goody says Liss Aske was twenty-five when she drowned, and Nala's face is hers not a day older.
She was a girl of twenty when Liss Aske drowned, and Liss was her friend.
The tarn's last drowned was Liss Aske, twenty-five and red-haired, fifty-one winters ago.

event: Garth: his mam told him of her, the Aske girl the tarn took.

memory.fact: Garth's mother told him of Liss Aske, the red-haired Aske girl the tarn took.
Garth's mother told him of Liss Aske, the red-haired Aske girl the tarn took.

event: Goody sniffs at Nala like a hound: "You smell of the Sea, girl. Clean and deep."

memory.fact: Goody Brannoc smells the Sea on Nala, clean and deep, as she has smelled it on no living thing.
Goody Brannoc smells the Sea on Nala, clean and deep, as she has smelled it on no living thing.

event: Garth tells her Nala drew Wren's rot into salt this morning; they burned it, and the leg is clean.

memory.fact: Garth told Goody that Nala drew the rot out of Wren's leg into salt, and Wren's leg is clean.
Garth told Goody that Nala drew the rot out of Wren's leg into salt, and Wren's leg is clean.

event: "Clean. Rot. Drawn out." Goody has buried four this winter.

memory.fact: She has watched rot kill four people this winter and could not stop it in any of them.
She has watched rot kill four people this winter and could not stop it in any of them.

event: Horne's Tansy: rot past her elbow, three days left if that. Will Nala come to the mill now?

memory.fact: Tansy Horne, the miller's girl of fourteen, has greymaw rot past the elbow and some three days left.
Tansy Horne, the miller's girl of fourteen, has greymaw rot past the elbow and some three days left.
Goody has asked Nala, whoever she is, to come to the mill now to Tansy Horne.
Goody has asked Nala, whoever she is, to come to the mill now to Tansy Horne.

event: The mill is a big stone mill with a slate-hung house joined on, its wheel groaning in the race.

memory.fact: Horne's mill is a big stone mill with a slate-hung house joined on, the finest in the valley.
Horne's mill is a big stone mill with a slate-hung house joined on, the finest in the valley.

event: A heavy, grey, hard-faced man fills the door: "Talented. A stranger. I've had my fill of promises."

memory.fact: Sedge Horne is heavy, grey and hard-faced, and trusts no Talented stranger, but trusts Goody.
Sedge Horne is heavy, grey and hard-faced, and trusts no Talented stranger, but trusts Goody.

event: "She drew the rot out of Garth's Wren this morning. I'll vouch for her. Move." Horne steps aside.

memory.fact: Goody Brannoc vouched for Nala to Sedge Horne as the one who drew the rot out of Wren.
Goody Brannoc vouched for Nala to Sedge Horne as the one who drew the rot out of Wren.

event: Upstairs a girl of fourteen lies grey and sweating; a worn woman holds her good hand.

memory.fact: Tansy's mother, Aud Horne, has not left her daughter's bedside in three days.
Tansy's mother, Aud Horne, has not left her daughter's bedside in three days.

event: Tansy's bandaged right arm: black veins crawl past her elbow toward her shoulder.

memory.fact: Tansy's rot is in her right arm; black veins crawl past her elbow toward her shoulder.
Tansy's rot is in her right arm; black veins crawl past her elbow toward her shoulder.

event: Nala's tide finds a sour tangle soaked through the arm, threaded deep into the girl's own life.

memory.fact: To Undertow, Tansy's rot is a sour tangle soaked through her arm, threaded deep into her life.
To Undertow, Tansy's rot is a sour tangle soaked through her arm, threaded deep into her life.
Tansy's rot runs far deeper than Wren's; drawing it clean takes near an hour of steady care.
Tansy's rot runs far deeper than Wren's; drawing it clean takes near an hour of steady care.

event: Horne, low and hard: "If you hurt her, Talented, I'll see you hang for it."

memory.fact: Sedge Horne swore he would see Nala hang if she hurt Tansy.
Sedge Horne swore he would see Nala hang if she hurt Tansy.

event: Nala warns it will be harder than Wren, and asks for a vessel for the rot and a fire to burn it.
Goody sets a wide earthenware basin by the bed; Horne will stoke the kitchen range below.

memory.fact: Goody set a wide earthenware basin by Tansy's bed to hold the rot Nala draws.
Goody set a wide earthenware basin by Tansy's bed to hold the rot Nala draws.
Horne's kitchen range, below Tansy's room, is lit and hot as a forge, and Horne stokes it.
Horne's kitchen range, below Tansy's room, is lit and hot as a forge, and Horne stokes it.

event: Palm on Tansy's forearm, Nala eases the first sour threads free, like untangling computer cords.
The room turns cold enough for gooseflesh and smells of the sea; Goody draws a sharp breath.

memory.fact: Goody's Knack feels Nala's drawing as gooseflesh and a cold sea-smell filling the room.
Goody's Knack feels Nala's drawing as gooseflesh and a cold sea-smell filling the room.

event: Further in, the threads grow finer, crossing and doubling back past telling apart.

memory.fact: Deep in Tansy's arm the rot threads grow finer, crossing and doubling back past telling apart.
Deep in Tansy's arm the rot threads grow finer, crossing and doubling back past telling apart.

event: She tugs one that isn't only sour, and Tansy's own warm life rushes up her arm into her well.

memory.fact: A thread that is not only rot drags the sick one's own warm life up her arm into her well.
A thread that is not only rot drags the sick one's own warm life up her arm into her well.

event: Tansy goes ashen, cold, blue-lipped, and swoons; only a pinch of salt came, the tangle near whole.

memory.fact: Nala's pull drank some of Tansy's own life; Tansy went ashen, cold and blue-lipped, and swooned.
Nala's pull drank some of Tansy's own life; Tansy went ashen, cold and blue-lipped, and swooned.
Nala's first try drew only a pinch of salt from Tansy; her rot is still nearly whole.
Nala's first try drew only a pinch of salt from Tansy; her rot is still nearly whole.

event: Horne hauls Nala off the bed by the collar and pins her to the wall: "What did you do to her?"

memory.fact: Sedge Horne hauled Nala off Tansy's bed by the collar, pinned her to the wall, and roared at her.
Sedge Horne hauled Nala off Tansy's bed by the collar, pinned her to the wall, and roared at her.

event: "Quiet!" The word cracks through the room, and Horne falls silent, fist still in her collar.
The girl's stolen warmth sits apart in Nala's well, like a pocket; she turns the tide to push.

memory.fact: Water she drew from a body stays apart and warm in her well a while, and goes back most easily.
Water she drew from a body stays apart and warm in her well a while, and goes back most easily.
Undertow's push can pour Water back into a body she has drained, if she keeps the flow gentle.
Undertow's push can pour Water back into a body she has drained, if she keeps the flow gentle.

event: The warmth slides back into Tansy, with a thin stream of Nala's own cold flow after it.

changes.note: Nala pours a thin stream of her own Water into Tansy

memory.fact: Nala pushed Tansy's warmth back into her with a little of her own Water; Tansy's blue lips faded.
Nala pushed Tansy's warmth back into her with a little of her own Water; Tansy's blue lips faded.
Her own Water given to another warms and steadies them, and holds rot back for days.
Her own Water given to another warms and steadies them, and holds rot back for days.

event: Tansy breathes deep; her colour returns, and Nala's flow holds the rot still as cold honey.

memory.fact: Nala's Water holds Tansy's rot still and sluggish, but nearly all of it is still in her arm.
Nala's Water holds Tansy's rot still and sluggish, but nearly all of it is still in her arm.

event: "Mam? I'm cold. I was so cold." Her mother sobs and gathers her in.

memory.fact: Tansy woke from her swoon, cold, and asked for her mam, who held her and wept.
Tansy woke from her swoon, cold, and asked for her mam, who held her and wept.

event: "Sedge Horne, let go of her." He does, then hoarsely asks: can she get the rest of it out?

memory.fact: At Goody's word Sedge Horne let Nala go, then asked if she could get the rest of the rot out.
At Goody's word Sedge Horne let Nala go, then asked if she could get the rest of the rot out.

event: "I'm making progress, but this will take time." Horne sits on a stool by the door, hands clenched.
This time Nala lets the tide breathe like surf: out, her own flow; in, one sour thread.

memory.fact: Giving Water and drawing rot in turn, like surf, is Undertow's own rhythm, and eases fine work.
Giving Water and drawing rot in turn, like surf, is Undertow's own rhythm, and eases fine work.

event: Each wave makes the fine work easier; whenever warmth follows the pull, the next push sends it back.
Grey salt builds grain by grain; each palmful goes into Goody's basin. The sun moves on the floor.
The black veins ebb a finger's width at a time, back past her elbow; something in the tide strains.

memory.fact: Threading Tansy's rot for an hour drives Undertow's finesse to its limit for the first time.

event: At the last hair-fine threads something gives like a door opening, and the tide widens.

changes.append: Draws from anything in its reach, not only what she touches.
changes.note: Undertow's first widening, threading Tansy's rot to its limit

memory.fact: Her Scope is not fixed: it widens each time she drives Undertow to its limit.

event: She can draw from anything in her reach now; she lifts her palm and the pull goes on across the gap.

memory.fact: Undertow's first widening lets her draw from anything in its reach, no longer only what she touches.
Undertow's first widening lets her draw from anything in its reach, no longer only what she touches.

event: The last sour threads crust grey on her raised palm; nothing sour is left in Tansy's arm.

changes.note: An hour threading Tansy's rot: a hard working

memory.fact: Nala drew all of Tansy's rot; the black veins are gone and her bite is an ordinary wound.
Nala drew all of Tansy's rot; the black veins are gone and her bite is an ordinary wound.

event: The basin holds a double handful of grey, stinking salt; the bite is an ordinary wound.

memory.fact: Tansy's rot comes out as a double handful of grey salt, too much to hold in one palm.
Tansy's rot comes out as a double handful of grey salt, too much to hold in one palm.

event: Goody unwinds the bandage and sniffs the bite, and her face crumples: "Clean. Clean."

memory.fact: Goody sniffed Tansy's bite after Nala's drawing and whispered, "Clean."
Goody sniffed Tansy's bite after Nala's drawing and whispered, "Clean."

event: Horne carries the basin down; the kitchen range roars and spits below. Tansy's mother weeps.
Nala's stomach growls; she is ravenous, as if after a long day's work, her head still clear.

changes.note: The Sea refills what she gave Tansy

memory.fact: An hour of fine drawing leaves Nala clear-headed but ravenous, as after a long day's work.
An hour of fine drawing leaves Nala clear-headed but ravenous, as after a long day's work.

event: Horne in the doorway, eyes wet: "Name your price. A silver bar. More. Anything I have."

memory.fact: Sedge Horne told Nala to name her price for saving Tansy: a silver bar, more, anything he has.
Sedge Horne told Nala to name her price for saving Tansy: a silver bar, more, anything he has.
Sedge Horne would pay a silver bar, or anything asked, to anyone who saved Tansy.
Sedge Horne would pay a silver bar, or anything asked, to anyone who saved Tansy.
